title: Claims on Charged Tailwise Autoship Shipments: Windows, Remedies and Refund Amounts
content:
**Claims desk guidance — Tailwise Autoship**

A claim is raised against one charged shipment, identified by that shipment's charge record. The claim reasons are damaged, missing, wrong item, quality guarantee and unopened return.

## 1. Window

A claim is accepted only if it is reported no later than the claim window after the claimed shipment's charge date. The window is counted in calendar days from the charge date shown on the claimed shipment's charge record, the charge date itself being day 0; a claim reported on the last day of the window is in time.

| Claim reason | Window used |
|---|---|
| damaged, wrong item | the program's damaged or wrong-item window |
| missing | the program's missing-shipment window |
| quality guarantee | the program's quality claim window, only where the program carries the satisfaction guarantee |
| unopened return | the program's unopened return window, only where that window is above 0 |

**Boundary (hypothetical, 7-day window).** Charge date is day 0. A claim reported on day 7 is in time; a claim reported on day 8 is not.

## 2. One remedy per shipment and reason

No refund or replacement already recorded refers to the same shipment charge with the same claim reason. A second claim for the same shipment and the same reason is therefore not accepted; a claim for the same shipment under a different reason is a separate claim.

## 3. Remedy

- For damaged, missing and wrong-item claims the customer chooses a free replacement where the program allows a replacement, otherwise a refund.
- Quality guarantee and unopened return claims are always refunded.
- Pharmacy items are never accepted as quality guarantee or unopened return claims; a dispensing error is handled by the pharmacy, not as an Autoship claim.

## 4. Refund amount

The refund is the claimed units' share of the shipment's merchandise subtotal after its Autoship discount — that net subtotal multiplied by the units claimed and divided by the units shipped — rounded half up to the cent, plus the shipping fee when every unit of the shipment is claimed and the program refunds the shipping fee on claims. Heavy-item surcharges and packaging fees are refunded only on damaged, missing and wrong-item claims covering every unit. The refund goes to the program's refund destination (original payment method, or Tailwise credit) and books out of the subscription's net billed total.

### Worked refunds (hypothetical shipment: 4 units, merchandise subtotal 100.00 USD, Autoship discount 5.00 USD, shipping fee 4.95 USD, heavy surcharge 0.00)

| Claim | Units claimed | Merchandise share | Shipping fee refunded | Refund |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| damaged | 1 | 95.00 times 1 divided by 4: 23.75 | No (not every unit) | 23.75 |
| missing | 4 | 95.00 | Yes, where the program refunds it | 99.95 |
| quality guarantee | 3 | 95.00 times 3 divided by 4: 71.25 | No (not every unit) | 71.25 |
